title: [DEV] AAPSclient misses downloads
body:
AAPS 3.2.0.1-dev a909f8653a-2023.10.25 NSClientV3 + websockets
NS dev v15.0.2 44f70db
Time 2023-10-28 around 0-5h
[Log Export 10-28.txt](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/13204242/Log.Export.10-28.txt)
Similar to #2748 #2932

Happened in the morning after turning on the AAPSclient device. Data is in NS, but TBR won't download. Missing data won't backfill, even if I force close AAPSclient, delete cache and restart NSClient.

![Screenshot_20231028-045800_AAPSClient](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/64865503/72080df8-a42b-4d44-a11b-8d4e3ed709cf)

![Screenshot_20231028_NS](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/64865503/71e652ba-2c77-490f-ba12-ba190ee2a245)

- select NSCv3 tab and from menu do full sync
After full sync missing data is there
